review_scope: Bounded source and assertion review at b901326c. Neither whole-clause nor whole-ADR certification. Draft/run statements describe reviewer handoff; current execution and parent qualifications are in findings.json and gate-results.json.

selected_adr_reviews.decision: Collections appear in existing Files panel; container page stays visible; no separate preview pane.

selected_adr_reviews.review: Keep as product policy if owner confirms row emphasis satisfies /D for this viewer. Do not state this interpretation as unambiguous normative text.
